limitations.modern_arkit_md: Same reference as modern_arkit; the trusted-subset p90 table is the simulation's calibration target.
limitations.drift_anatomy: Within-walk scale variation and along-travel share; no row measures a two-tap difference (clearance) error directly.
limitations.budget_md: Modeled device budget, not a measurement; anchors local_clearance.
limitations.budget_json: Modeled device budget, not a measurement; anchors local_clearance.
limitations.rules_yaml: 0.3/1.5 ft bases and the 0.16 ft/ft rate are day-1 estimates; the rate is calibrated to S1 real-data evals (PR #12) on a 2018 iPhone 6s only. Citation review reused from PR #217 (obv/basescanning-024).
limitations.evals_readme: Summary prose; the numbers it quotes are pinned to their tables.
